:box:Contributing to criminal chaos of the `text(1920s)` was the sudden rise of the Ku Klux Klan, or KKK. In the `text(early 1920s)`, membership in the KKK quickly escalated to `text(six)` figures under the leadership of “Colonel” William Simmons and advertising guru Edward Young Clarke.

By the middle of the `text(decade)`, the group boasted several `text(million)` members. The crimes committed in the name of its [discriminatory] beliefs were despicable... The Klan had become a clear threat to public safety and order.

	-from the “KKK Series” on the FBI website
